messages:
jordan_l: Heads-up: customer reported garbled tokens after an auth-refresh reconnect. Looks like chunks replayed out of order.
jordan_l: Repro (flaky): start stream -> force auth refresh (client reconnect) -> resume token present -> final output contains earlier chunk after later chunk.

mira: Which client? Node or browser sample app?

jordan_l: Node sample-app v0.9.5. We use resume_token in query param, not Last-Event-ID.

oscar: Do we have raw SSE frames? Need to check event boundaries. If frames split mid-token, reassembly + replay order can go wrong.

jordan_l: Wire log (trimmed):
```
[15:03:02.123Z] evt id=205 part=1 data="The quick b"
[15:03:02.124Z] connection: reset
[15:03:02.125Z] reconnect resume=rt_xxx
[15:03:02.127Z] evt id=206 part=1 data="Another"
[15:03:02.128Z] replay id=205 part=2 data="rown fox"
```
jordan_l: Client emitted: "The quick bAnotherrown fox" -> ordering wrong.

mira: Looks like proxy replayed id=205 part=2 after id=206 started. Probably because we flush the proxy's outgoing queue async when client disconnects.

oscar: We changed tail-ack to async in the proxy for perf last month. That means buffered fragments might be sent after resume stream starts.

ingest-bot: ticket created: STREAM-1123 (priority P2)

qa_sam: Quick mitigation: client can buffer by (event id, part) and assemble when all parts seen or after a short gap. Do we want to add a small ordering layer in SDK?

mira: Yes, add protective reordering in SDKs. But runtime/proxy should also guarantee not to interleave replayed messages with new inflight ones.

oscar: Agreed. Proposal: introduce explicit X-Chunk-Seq and X-Chunk-Part headers so reconstructor can sort deterministically. Also ensure proxy drains buffered queue before emitting resumed replay.

jordan_l: I'll open a tiny node-sdk PR to buffer and sort on reconnect. Link when ready.

mira: Also add a unit/integration that simulates a flappy connection with mixed replay and inflight to prevent regressions.

jordan_l: PR: https://git.internal/r/node-sdk/389 (adds buffering + flaky test).

ingest-bot: deploy: node-sdk/sampleapp/0.9.6 -> canary at 2026-03-20T09:08:15Z by qa_sam

qa_sam: Can confirm canary on staging reproduced earlier issue and the SDK buffering fixed final ordering for the test case. Still want runtime change though.

mira: Filing runtime follow-up: PROXY-678 to add drain-before-resume flag and X-Chunk-Seq header support.

jordan_l: Thanks. Shipping SDK patch and filing runtime ticket. We'll update docs in docs/streaming-retries.md after runtime change is merged. :thumbsup:
